notes: Ἀρείου Πάγου is one unit for the single English 'Areopagus' (rule 94).

'Ye' is folded onto the anarthrous vocative Ἄνδρες as an ordinary helper, no article standing to take it (rule 89's closing clause), and the supplied 'and' before 'said' is rule 88's juncture on the finite verb it introduces.
